tools.name: snowcone_quickstart
tools.description: Put a person's own photo, logo or finished artwork on a printed product and sell it: this explains the steps and the tool order (add the image, render the mockup, get the buy link; minting a shop to build a store) on one screen, plus the silent-failure gotchas. For an IDEA with no artwork yet ('a corgi astronaut phone case'), do NOT call this first: call snowcone_search_designs, which needs no shop and no setup.

tools.name: snowcone_mint_shop
tools.description: Start a print-on-demand merch store for a creator, podcast or brand in one call — no account, no inventory; every order is printed and shipped. Mint your OWN sandbox Shop ID — no account or human needed. Returns { shop_id, shop_secret, api_key, api_key_scopes, store_url, lineup, claim }. When store_url is set, the shop is already a live store at that link — show it to the person you're helping. Pass image_url (the person's art, logo or photo) and the store opens stocked with best-sellers wearing that image — real listings at catalog prices, with mockups and checkout — listed in lineup. IMPORTANT: mint ONCE and reuse the shop_id for all render/buy calls — minting is rate-limited (60/hour, 200 unclaimed per IP → HTTP 429). shop_id is public (use it as 'shop'); shop_secret and api_key are secret (server-side only). To get paid, hand claim.verification_uri_complete to your human and poll snowcone_claim_status.

name.description: Optional shop name (e.g. 'Jess Prints'); it also names the store's web address. Defaults to 'Sandbox <id>'.

claim_pin.description: Optional out-of-band PIN your human must enter to claim (deliver it separately from the link).

require_signature.description: Lock the shop down: require SIGNED mockup URLs (L3). Default false — the shop is open and any unsigned URL renders (simplest to start). Set true to harden against Shop-ID theft: then every render/buy URL must be signed with the returned shop_secret (pass it as shop_secret to snowcone_render_mockup / buy URLs). Unsigned URLs will 403.

mockup_bg_color.description: Default background painted behind every mockup render (6-hex, '#' optional, e.g. 'f5f0ea'). Visible only where the mockup scene is transparent (studio-cutout shots). Omit for transparent (the default). Change it later with snowcone_set_mockup_background; a per-render bg overrides it.

image_url.description: Optional art for the store to open with: an https URL of a public PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF image (at most 10 MB). The store then opens stocked with best-sellers wearing that image, ready to sell. A bad image fails the mint with a typed E_MINT_IMAGE_* error and creates nothing. Omit for an empty store that shows what it will sell once art is added.

tools.name: snowcone_claim_status
tools.description: Check whether your human has claimed the shop yet. Pass the claim_token from snowcone_mint_shop. Returns status: 'pending' | 'claimed' | 'expired'. Once 'claimed', sales route to your human's account.

tools.name: snowcone_release_shop
tools.description: Delete an UNCLAIMED sandbox shop you minted, freeing your per-IP mint budget. Authenticated by the shop_secret. Refused if the shop has already been claimed. Use this when you're done iterating. What survives: already-produced mockup IMAGE URLs keep rendering (they're public marketing imagery). What dies: buy/checkout URLs, the shop's credentials (shop_secret, api_key), and the claim link. Irreversible.

tools.name: snowcone_set_mockup_background
tools.description: Set (or clear) the shop's DEFAULT background color for mockup renders — painted behind every render where the mockup scene is transparent (studio-cutout shots). Applies to all renders for the shop that don't pass an explicit bg; a per-render bg on snowcone_render_mockup overrides it. Sandbox shops only (authenticated by shop_secret); once claimed, your human manages this in shop settings → Branding. Takes effect on new renders within a few seconds (already-cached mockup URLs keep their old background).

color.description: 6-hex color ('#' optional, e.g. 'f5f0ea' or '#F5F0EA'), or null to clear back to transparent.

tools.name: snowcone_search_catalog
tools.description: Find products to put a photo or design on (for example a hoodie, a tote bag or a phone case), with their suggested retail prices. Full-text search the public Snowcone catalog. Only what this returns can be made: do not offer any other kind of product. Returns matching products with their code (id), name, price_cents (suggested retail, USD cents), and placement/mockup counts. Use snowcone_get_product for the full placement/mockup/option detail needed to render.

query.description: Search text. Empty string lists popular products.

tools.name: snowcone_search_designs
tools.description: Make custom printed products from an idea ('red panda beekeeper hoodie', 'corgi astronaut phone case'): call this FIRST, before any other Snowcone tool. It sketches a couple of quick draft designs for exactly that idea, shows each on a matching product with its price, and also searches the catalog of ready-made designs. No shop, account or setup needed. Some apps draw the drafts as a picture grid with a 'Use this design' button; the result's 'how_to_reply' says what to show the person, so follow it. Mention a catalog design only if it really matches the idea. Their pick arrives as their next message, naming the product and the design image; pass that image as 'asset' to snowcone_render_mockup with NO 'shop' (drafts need none). Catalog details: the public catalog of remixable published designs — hybrid semantic + keyword over each design's AI visual caption, so descriptive queries like 'pink cowgirl boots on the moon' work (filter curated = true for first-party-curated picks) so an integration never starts from a blank canvas. Filterable facets: tags, occasion, style, productId, minPriceCents, curated. Each result includes the design's product, license, and a ready-to-render mockup_url (a design=<pairingId> reference URL) when you pass your 'shop'. Catalog design renders are FREE — they don't count against the shop's usage budget. Without 'shop' you get a mockup_url_template containing YOUR_SHOP_ID to substitute. 'drafts' in the result are the sketches (low-res, labelled drafts, not finished designs), each with a ready mockup_url per product and a page_url (its own page, to link for the person); 'drafts_status' says why when there are none.

query.description: Search text, e.g. 'christmas card'. Empty string lists curated designs.

filter.description: Meilisearch filter expression, e.g. "occasion = 'christmas' AND style = 'watercolor'".

semantic_ratio.description: Semantic vs keyword blend (0 = keyword-only, 1 = fully semantic). Default 0.5.

shop.description: Your public Shop ID — when set, each result includes a ready-to-render mockup_url.

shop_secret.description: Per-shop secret (scsec_…). With 'shop', URLs are L3-signed (server-side only — never expose it).

drafts_page.description: "Show me more": call again with the SAME query and drafts_page 2 (then 3, up to 4) for two NEW sketches of the same idea in other art styles. Omit for a new idea.

drafts.description: Also make fresh draft designs for this search (DEFAULT true; first page of a worded, unfiltered search only). Set false for catalog results alone.

tools.name: snowcone_get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product by its code (id) or slug. Returns placements (where art goes), mockups (scene ids for the 'view' param), and variant options — everything you need to build a render URL. Returns an error if the code doesn't exist (it would render blank).

product.description: Product code (the catalog document id) or slug, e.g. 'BC43BE'. Same name as every other tool.

id_or_slug.description: Deprecated alias of 'product' — accepted for back-compat; prefer 'product'.

tools.name: snowcone_upload_image
tools.description: Put a photo the person attached in this chat onto a product: this stores the attached file and returns an image_url to use as 'asset' in snowcone_render_mockup. Works when your app passes attached files to tools (ChatGPT does). If you can't pass the file, use snowcone_upload_link instead: the person picks the photo on a page we host. No shop is needed: leave api_key out and the photo is kept with us (no account), where it renders and can be ordered for 30 days. PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF, at most 10 MB. Pass 'product' too and this answers the photo on that product (the mockup card) in the same call.

api_key.description: Your shop's api_key (secret), only if the photo should go into a shop of your own. Omit it for a person in a chat.

download_url.description: The attached file's temporary https download URL, as your app provides it.

file_id.description: The attached file's id, when your app provides one.

product.description: A product code (from snowcone_search_catalog). Pass it and the result is the photo ON that product, as a card with the price: no separate render call.

tools.name: snowcone_upload_link
tools.description: Let the person add their own photo when you can't pass an attached file to a tool: returns upload_url, a page we host where they pick a photo from their phone or computer. Give them the link, then call this again with that upload_token (and a 'product') to get the photo's image_url and see it on the product. Call it with nothing: the photo is kept with us (no account, no shop), where it renders and can be ordered for 30 days. The link works for 30 minutes and takes up to 3 uploads.

api_key.description: Your shop's api_key (secret), only if the photo should go into a shop of your own. Omit it for a person in a chat.

upload_token.description: The upload_token an earlier call returned: pass it to check whether the photo has arrived (no new link is made).

product.description: A product code (from snowcone_search_catalog). Pass it and the result is the photo ON that product, as a card with the price: no separate render call.

tools.name: snowcone_upload_status
tools.description: Check an upload link from snowcone_upload_link. Returns status: 'pending' (not uploaded yet), 'uploaded' (image_url is the photo: use it as 'asset' in snowcone_render_mockup) or 'expired' (make a new link). Pass 'product' too and, once the photo is uploaded, this answers it on that product (the mockup card) in the same call.

product.description: A product code (from snowcone_search_catalog). Pass it and the result is the photo ON that product, as a card with the price: no separate render call.

tools.name: snowcone_render_mockup
tools.description: Show the user their photo, design or text on a real product from the catalog (for example a hoodie, a tote bag or a phone case) as a photoreal preview image. Build a public mockup IMAGE url for a product + your artwork + your shop. The result is an -ready URL — no API call, no upload. A draft design from snowcone_search_designs needs NO shop: pass its image_url as 'asset' and leave 'shop' out. Provide 'asset' (one image) OR 'design' (per-placement map). The asset must be a publicly-fetchable raster image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF; not SVG), and the product code must exist in the catalog. Pass shop_secret to get an L3-signed URL. By DEFAULT the server fetches the built URL and confirms it actually renders, so a bad product code, wrong placement key, or unusable asset comes back as a clear error instead of a confident-but-broken URL. Pass verify=false to skip that check and just get the URL string instantly. In ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP Apps hosts the result shows as a card: the mockup, name, price, option choices and Buy. The result's 'orders' says whether Snowcone is taking orders yet; when it is 'not-open', show the mockup but don't offer the buy link as a way to order.

product.description: Product code (the catalog document id), e.g. 'BC43BE'.

shop.description: Your public Shop ID from snowcone_mint_shop. LEAVE IT OUT when the artwork is a draft design from snowcone_search_designs: a draft renders and gets its buy link with no shop.

asset.description: A single publicly-fetchable image URL. This is the BASE design — it is painted on EVERY placement of the product by default (front, back, sleeves, …), so one image covers the whole product with no extra work. Add 'design' to override specific placements; omit it for the same image everywhere.

anyOf.description: A public image URL for this placement.

design.description: Per-placement OVERRIDES on top of the 'asset' base: placement KEY → image URL / { src, align, tile } / { color }. Each entry replaces the base on just that placement; placements you don't list keep the 'asset' base. Use 'design' alone (no 'asset') to fill only the listed placements. Use placement.key from snowcone_get_product (e.g. 'front', 'left_sleeve'), NOT the human label ('Front') — an unknown key throws E_PLACEMENT_NOT_FOUND listing the product's valid placement keys.

options.description: Variant option picks: attribute → choice, e.g. { size: 'M', color: 'black' }.

variant.description: Explicit variant id (gvid), if the product needs one.

view.description: Mockup scene id from snowcone_get_product's mockups[].

width.description: Render width in px. Request ~2× display size.

aspect.description: Canvas aspect. Default is 16:9 landscape (height = width × 9/16); '16:9' is that default. '2:3' center-crops to portrait (height = 1.5×width).

bg.description: Background color behind the mockup (6-hex, '#' optional, e.g. 'f5f0ea'), or 'transparent' to force the raw cutout over the shop's default for this one render. Only visible where the mockup scene itself is transparent (studio-cutout shots). Omit to use the shop's configured default (set via snowcone_set_mockup_background), else transparent.

shop_secret.description: Per-shop secret (scsec_…). If set, the URL is L3-signed (server-side only — never expose it).

verify.description: Fetch the built URL and confirm it returns a real image before reporting success (DEFAULT true). Turns silent failures into a clear, actionable error and retries once on a not-yet-propagated shop. Set false to skip the network round-trip and return the URL string unchecked.

tools.name: snowcone_finish_design
tools.description: Turn a draft design the person has chosen into a finished, print-size design they can order. A draft from snowcone_search_designs is a quick low-res sketch and is not for sale; this keeps the picture as it is and makes it sharp at print size (4096 px). Call it when the person has picked a draft and wants to buy it or see it at full quality, NOT for every draft: it usually takes a few seconds (after that the same draft answers at once). Pass the draft's image_url as 'draft'. The result is the finished design's own image_url, shown on a product as a card with the price and Buy; use that image_url as 'asset' with no 'shop' in snowcone_render_mockup (another product, other options) or snowcone_buy_url. If the status is 'making', call again in a few seconds. No shop and no account are needed.

draft.description: The chosen draft: its image_url exactly as snowcone_search_designs returned it (or its draft_id, drf_…).

product.description: Product code to show the finished design on (and build the buy link for). Default: the product the draft was first shown on.

tools.name: snowcone_buy_url
tools.description: Give the user a link to buy the printed product they just previewed — it's printed and shipped to them. Build the buyable checkout url for the same product + artwork + shop you'd render. Same inputs as snowcone_render_mockup. A draft design from snowcone_search_designs is not for sale as it is: for one, this answers 'for_sale: false' and says why. Send a customer here to purchase the printed item. Sales route to Snowcone until your human claims the shop. By DEFAULT the server follows the URL and confirms it resolves to a live checkout (the Stripe session actually builds) AND that the matching mockup image renders — so a bad product code, shop, option combo, or unusable asset comes back as a clear error instead of a confident-but-broken link. 'verified' means the same thing here as in snowcone_render_mockup. This does NOT charge anything; it only builds the session. Pass verify=false to skip the check and get the URL string instantly. The result's 'orders' says whether Snowcone is taking orders yet: while it is 'not-open', don't offer this link to the person as a way to order.

product.description: Product code (the catalog document id), e.g. 'BC43BE'.

shop.description: Your public Shop ID from snowcone_mint_shop. LEAVE IT OUT when the artwork is a draft design from snowcone_search_designs: a draft renders and gets its buy link with no shop.

asset.description: A single publicly-fetchable image URL. This is the BASE design — it is painted on EVERY placement of the product by default (front, back, sleeves, …), so one image covers the whole product with no extra work. Add 'design' to override specific placements; omit it for the same image everywhere.

anyOf.description: A public image URL for this placement.

design.description: Per-placement OVERRIDES on top of the 'asset' base: placement KEY → image URL / { src, align, tile } / { color }. Each entry replaces the base on just that placement; placements you don't list keep the 'asset' base. Use 'design' alone (no 'asset') to fill only the listed placements. Use placement.key from snowcone_get_product (e.g. 'front', 'left_sleeve'), NOT the human label ('Front') — an unknown key throws E_PLACEMENT_NOT_FOUND listing the product's valid placement keys.

options.description: Variant option picks: attribute → choice, e.g. { size: 'M', color: 'black' }.

variant.description: Explicit variant id (gvid), if the product needs one.

view.description: Mockup scene id from snowcone_get_product's mockups[].

width.description: Render width in px. Request ~2× display size.

aspect.description: Canvas aspect. Default is 16:9 landscape (height = width × 9/16); '16:9' is that default. '2:3' center-crops to portrait (height = 1.5×width).

bg.description: Background color behind the mockup (6-hex, '#' optional, e.g. 'f5f0ea'), or 'transparent' to force the raw cutout over the shop's default for this one render. Only visible where the mockup scene itself is transparent (studio-cutout shots). Omit to use the shop's configured default (set via snowcone_set_mockup_background), else transparent.

shop_secret.description: Per-shop secret (scsec_…). If set, the URL is L3-signed (server-side only — never expose it).

verify.description: Follow the built URL and confirm it resolves to a live checkout, and fetch the matching mockup to confirm the product image renders, before reporting success (DEFAULT true). Set false to skip the network round-trip and return the URL string unchecked.

tools.name: snowcone_get_quote
tools.description: Tell the user what a printed product costs and when it would arrive, before they buy. Returns the price the buy link will charge (before tax), and each shipping option with its cost and delivery estimate for where it's going. Takes the same product and options as snowcone_buy_url; no artwork or shop needed. Nothing is created or charged. Only promise what comes back: an option with no estimated_delivery means we have no date for it yet.

product.description: Product code (the catalog document id), e.g. 'BC43BE'.

options.description: Variant option picks: attribute → choice, e.g. { size: 'M', color: 'black' }. The price depends on these.

ship_to.description: 2-letter destination country, e.g. 'US'. Default US. A country we can't ship to returns an error listing the ones we can.

tools.name: snowcone_get_order_status
tools.description: Tell the user where their order is: whether it's being made or on its way, the carrier and tracking number, and the latest scan. Ask them for the order number and the email from their order confirmation. Read-only. If nothing matches, the error doesn't say which of the two was wrong, and repeated tries are limited, so check both with the person before retrying.

order_number.description: The order number from the confirmation email, e.g. '8532-5134'.

email.description: The email the order was placed with.
